_about: Parameters for the diffusion simulator (js/simulator.js). Small-firm adoption follows a logistic S-curve starting at 11% in 2025 (ABS 2026, F34) and reaching 50% in year t50. The productivity level gain at time t is task_gain x exposed_share x adoption(t), the Hulten logic in Acemoglu (2025, F4). exposed_share is calibrated once so the baseline reproduces the PC's central 4.3% labour productivity gain over 2025-2035 (F21). See docs/methods.md.

upside.name: Adoption-focused policy
upside.task_gain_source: Assumption: deeper reorganisation lifts the average gain towards the 34% seen for novices (F8). Output lands inside CommBank's 0.8-1.0pp range (F51)

downside.name: Infrastructure first
downside.t50_source: Assumption: a five-year lag on JSA scenario 1, by analogy with JSA's non-market lag (F43)
downside.task_gain_source: Assumption: bolt-on adoption without reorganisation halves the gain (GPT prediction, Berg Week 1; J-curve, F5). Output lands near the bottom of the PC's study range (F19)
